#7 rows
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(shadowtext)
library(dplyr)

# ── Data: 7 rows — 5 species 2D + 2 finfish 3D ───────────────────────────────
# Add spacer rows between species groups
spacers <- data.frame(
  species   = c("_spacer1", "_spacer2"),
  minimum   = c(NA, NA),
  actual    = c(NA, NA),
  maximum   = c(NA, NA),
  approach  = c("2D", "2D"),
  show_actual_label = c(FALSE, FALSE)
)

val_data_all <- data.frame(
  species  = c("Atl.Salmon (2D)",  "Atl.Salmon (3D)",
               "_spacer1",
               "Oysters (2D)",
               "Prawn (2D)",
               "_spacer2",
               "S.B.Tuna (2D)",    "S.B.Tuna (3D)",
               "Barramundi (2D)"),
  minimum  = c(round(prod_low, 0),          round(cor_vol_prod_low, 0),
               NA,
               round(oyster_prod_low, 0),
               round(prawn_prod_low, 0),
               NA,
               round(sbt_prod_low, 0),       round(sbt_vol_prod_low, 0),
               round(barra_prod_low, 0)),
  actual   = c(actual_production,            actual_production,
               NA,
               oyster_actual_production,
               prawn_actual_production,
               NA,
               sbt_actual_production,         sbt_actual_production,
               barra_actual_production),
  maximum  = c(round(prod_high, 0),          round(cor_vol_prod_high, 0),
               NA,
               round(oyster_prod_high, 0),
               round(prawn_prod_high, 0),
               NA,
               round(sbt_prod_high, 0),       round(sbt_vol_prod_high, 0),
               round(barra_prod_high, 0)),
  approach = c("2D", "3D",
               "2D",
               "2D",
               "2D",
               "2D",
               "2D", "3D",
               "2D"),
  show_actual_label = c(TRUE,  FALSE,
                        FALSE,
                        TRUE,
                        TRUE,
                        FALSE,
                        TRUE,  FALSE,
                        TRUE)
)

val_data_all$species <- factor(val_data_all$species,
                               levels = c("Atl.Salmon (2D)",
                                          "Atl.Salmon (3D)",
                                          "_spacer1",
                                          "Oysters (2D)",
                                          "Prawn (2D)",
                                          "_spacer2",
                                          "S.B.Tuna (2D)",
                                          "S.B.Tuna (3D)",
                                          "Barramundi (2D)"))

col_min    <- "#0072B2"
col_actual <- "#009E73"
col_max    <- "#D55E00"
col_2d     <- "grey75"
col_3d     <- "grey45"
tick_h     <- 0.25

p_all <- ggplot(val_data_all, aes(y = species)) +

  # Range bar — thickness and colour by approach
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = maximum, yend = species,
                   colour = approach, linewidth = approach),
               lineend = "butt") +

  scale_colour_manual(values = c("2D" = col_2d, "3D" = col_3d),
                      guide = "none") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("2D" = 2.5, "3D" = 1.5),
                         guide = "none") +

  # Minimum tick
  geom_segment(aes(x = minimum, xend = minimum,
                   y = as.numeric(species) - tick_h,
                   yend = as.numeric(species) + tick_h),
               colour = col_min, linewidth = 2, lineend = "round") +

  # Maximum tick
  geom_segment(aes(x = maximum, xend = maximum,
                   y = as.numeric(species) - tick_h,
                   yend = as.numeric(species) + tick_h),
               colour = col_max, linewidth = 2, lineend = "round") +

  # Actual tick
  geom_segment(aes(x = actual, xend = actual,
                   y = as.numeric(species) - tick_h,
                   yend = as.numeric(species) + tick_h),
               colour = col_actual, linewidth = 2, lineend = "round") +

  # Minimum label — LEFT of tick
  geom_text(aes(x = minimum, label = comma(minimum)),
            vjust = 0.1, hjust = 1.15, size = 3.8,
            fontface = "bold", colour = col_min) +

  # Maximum label — RIGHT of tick
  geom_text(aes(x = maximum, label = comma(maximum)),
            vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.15, size = 3.8,
            fontface = "bold", colour = col_max) +

  # Actual label — ABOVE tick
  geom_shadowtext(data = filter(val_data_all, show_actual_label),
                  aes(x = actual, label = comma(actual)),
                  vjust = -1.8, hjust = 0.5, size = 3.8,
                  fontface = "bold", colour = col_actual,
                  bg.colour = "white", bg.r = 0.15) +
  
 scale_x_continuous(labels = comma,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.12))) +
 scale_y_discrete(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 0.6)),
    labels = function(x) ifelse(startsWith(x, "_spacer"), "", x)
  ) +

  labs(
    title    = "Production Validation: Actual vs. Modelled Range by Species",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "\u2502 Min (blue)   \u25cf Actual ABARES (green)   \u2502 Max (red)   ",
      "\u2015\u2015 thick = 2D empirical   thin = 3D corrected volumetric (finfish only)"),
    x = "Production (tonnes)",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40", hjust = 0,
                                      margin = margin(b = 12)),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold",
                                      margin = margin(t = 8)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey92"),
    plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin        = margin(15, 25, 15, 15)
  )

print(p_all)

ggsave(here("figures/Production_Validation_All_2D3D.png"),
       plot = p_all, width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
cat("\n✓ Combined 2D/3D validation plot saved\n")
```
